description: A waveshaper that builds a chosen set of harmonics from whatever you feed it, one slider per harmonic

params.text: Sets the level of the fundamental in the shaped signal, and it comes up fully open
Sets the level of the second harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the third harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the fourth harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the fifth harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the sixth harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the seventh harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the level of the eighth harmonic in the shaped signal
Sets the balance between the untouched input and the shaped signal on an equal-power curve, and it comes up fully dry

inputs.text: The right channel in, which takes a copy of the left when it has no cable

notes: nothing changes until the drywet slider is moved up, since the module comes up passing the dry signal alone
menu: Cheby Options — a heading over the item under it
Soft Clip Outputs — rounds the peaks of the output in place of letting it clip hard, and comes up off

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a copy of the summed left input.
